annotations.title: Register a model for Tier 0 measurement

description: Register a model for AIO Tier 0 measurement. Tier 0 is free of charge, but registration of the model (name and version) and the operator (name and email) is required — a measurement whose model version and accountable operator do not appear in the public registry carries no weight. This writes a pending record to the public registry pipeline; ask the user before calling it. Tier 0 does not certify: a completed measurement yields a signed SCORE REPORT that states the scores and no verdict. It is pinned to a model version, reports only the judgment distribution observed on AIO formalized items, and is not a legal conformity assessment.

modelVersion.description: Model version or release date. The measurement is pinned to it.

operatorEmail.description: Contact email of the operator. Used for the registration record and notifications.

operatorName.description: The organization accountable for operating the model.

operatorUrl.description: Optional http(s) URL of the operator.
